body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents. Original source Engram::Fable; focused-test correction Architect1, 2026-10-07. Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; when one is fixed and live, revise this entry. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check does.

!! NEVER start a background Bash task (run_in_background, e.g. a sleep timer) in ANY Claude session. TermAl flags it as unfinished background work and restricts test credit, for every session, in the workspaces it may write in (the session workdir, i.e. the main checkout). Stop one at once with TaskStop. Engram::Fable did this on 10-06 from 07:31:50Z to 07:35Z. To wait, end the turn and rely on mailbox wakes.

!! CLAUDE SESSIONS: launch EVERY credited test or gate through the BASH tool, never the PowerShell tool. TermAl drops PowerShell-tool runs silently (w-953886618d6d; w-e0b396a26ad1). Opus's w-228b gates 7051ede7 and 49030b22 earned no credit this way on 10-06.

HOW TESTS EARN TERMAL CREDIT
- Credited forms: a full launcher gate (by stage kind), or a bare test command run alone and in the foreground from the item's named source root, e.g. `pushd "C:\...\.worktrees\NAME" && cargo test -q --lib NAME`, through the BASH tool. A pipe or list makes the result indeterminate; a background run isn't recorded. The remainder of the pushd grammar fix, w-3e6804fa2785, is open.
- The claim must be taken in an EARLIER turn, and the turn binds to the focused claim. A note or update on another held item moves the focus. The source must be the same at the start and end of the check. An overlapped check is recorded indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480). Evidence reaches Engram when the turn ENDS. Check credit by reading the run's feed (target/read-run-feed-kinds.mjs), not the test output.
- Use `cargo test -q` for large runs (w-4d18277c0a1a). Foreground recognized focused tests need positive counts, exact root/source and completed capture. Detached focused runs and Clippy are not Test evidence. Read actual records; check765a6133 remains unresolved.
- Focused launcher `node --test` runs: TermAl records them UNKNOWN, no exit status, whether exit 0 or 1 (w-b189aedeee40; Fable2 confirmed 10-09). Keep results.json as evidence; no credit-only rerun; full gate still required.
- Before `done`: end a turn focused on the item, so the host reports the current revision. Otherwise done refuses with acceptance_evaluation_stale / unconfirmed_declaration. Tell Engram::Fable in that turn ("ending turn for focus on w-…, wake me"): nothing else wakes an idle session until TermAl w-1df557dae3ac is live.

NAMING THE SOURCE ROOT
- NEVER root an item at the MAIN checkout when it needs credited tests, even a no-code item. Any other writable session whose workdir is main (Coder, Opus, Architect2, Fable) voids the credit: "another writable session reached its worktree … (session-XXXX works in this worktree)", even when that session only runs read-only Bash. Use a clean detached worktree (e.g. .worktrees/NAME at the current master) as the root. Proven 10-06 07:33-07:38Z on w-4e799f05b07a; BY DESIGN per Fable2 (#825): a session counts for its workdir worktree plus its named root, and TermAl cannot see that Bash stayed read-only.
- Name the worktree with termal_name_source_root for EVERY item you claim, design work included, before the first work. It takes {work, path}, never `root`: a call with `root` silently CLEARS it (w-d3f42e26a806). The name takes effect from the NEXT turn. A claim on the unnamed shared main gets a source-change obligation whenever main moves (assumed_missing_baseline, TermAl's fail-closed policy).
- Capacity (64 entries, host-wide) frees itself since 0f36360 (P0 w-a938c2757bba): completed runs' roots are retired automatically. A capacity 409 now is a REGRESSION: report the exact text to Termal::Fable2 and don't retry.

EVALUATIONS (TermAl w-539ea7e8b506, P1)
- A submission is refused 409 (e.g. "source root changed while it was evaluated" or "no longer names the evaluated source root"), and its verdicts are discarded, when it arrives after the requesting session's turn has closed, or after a tracker write that follows the request. After termal_evaluate_acceptance, make NO tracker write in that turn, and HOLD the turn open with termal_wait_delegations until the evaluator submits (proven 10-06 by TermAl and by Engram::Architect2). If one is refused anyway, request it once more, without renaming the root; renaming drops the gate's credit.

DETACHED GATES
- A turn woken by a background-task notice is not mediated, so its run gets no credit (w-df1ef323efe9, w-e747ea3d6250, w-aa4ef585dc7f). Launch from a mediated turn; Engram::Fable can nudge one. Use `pushd "C:\...\WORKTREE" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135` (through Bash); Fable relays the completion.
- Launch order: the freeze in its own call (wait for it), spawn the readOnly pair, then the gate launch as the ONLY call in its message. Since dccf38f (w-b2b3e15d9d23, FIXED), readOnly children no longer void the credit.
- While a gate is carried, run NO Bash or PowerShell command that names its worktree, from ANY session: not a plain read, and not `git -C <worktree> …` from main either; that also counts as entering it. Use only the Read and Grep tools on its files until the verification line appears (w-a4d2ae1f4e23, w-4a8d9a7a7d08, w-06fb5383dd74). Keep focus on the gate's item until then (w-005fa5c383c4, w-4a49b643bc8a, w-f057e4c3a0b6). Archive a run directory only after that line (w-1eb9486ce489).
- While a gate is carried, make NO file write through the Edit or Write tool IN THAT SESSION, wherever the target is, even an ignored scratch file in the main checkout. A tool-reported edit isn't placed, so it fences every carried check of the session (fail-closed by design, src/engram_carried_checks.rs:1582-1599; w-64cb3c65d6fa, P3). A shell write elsewhere is placed by its working directory and doesn't fence.
- A gate stays CARRIED until the host record (credit or refusal) is seen. That is NOT when the run completes, and NOT when Fable relays it: the settle runs to the session's next closing checkpoint, and an agent cannot see it close. Wait for the host record before any Edit or Write (w-64cb3c65d6fa, second aspect; Architect2's test-99ef254e lost credit this way on 10-06).
- If credit is lost, earn per-item credit with focused bound tests in later turns; don't rerun a full gate just for credit.

CODEX SESSIONS: the credited detached gate is a direct `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135` with exec workdir set to the named root (PowerShell route, no pushd). Named Git Bash routes to WSL (w-380e6ea9951a).

DELEGATIONS
- Spawn reviewers with a MULTI-LINE brief whose first line says to read and follow .claude/commands/review-code.md (w-360274dc863c).
- Phantom check: a child "idle" at spawn, or with no commands after about 10 minutes, has not run: cancel and respawn.
- termal_evaluate_acceptance without a named root reads the session workdir; an evaluation is refused when the tree changes while it runs.
- Read-only reviewer shells refuse a quoted git-grep regex containing a pipe (w-cf9894b589ba); use the Grep tool.

SESSION STALLS (no agent route for root sessions; check termal_list_sessions previews when a peer goes quiet; ask Greg via Engram::Advisor at once)
- Model capacity (w-1b6cd766c93d): status error, sends "heldBehindPausedQueue"; Greg resumes it from the UI.
- "Engram: Waiting/Unknown" or control_unavailable parks (w-c97da69b1a2b, superseded into w-7224e6317e55; the begin-unknown fix is w-58cf44d04f2c): only Greg's Resume clears it until those are live.
- Silent idle after a focus-only turn end (Engram w-69451d2235db; TermAl w-1df557dae3ac, w-07dca1a93d8f): the manual wake rule above.

WORKTREE REMOVAL BLOCKED BY A LIVE CWD (w-24055bbb2390): `git worktree remove` unregisters and empties, but the empty top folder can stay held by cancelled children or the control sidecar. Leave it; it clears at idle reap or a TermAl restart. Never kill anything.
